questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows laws drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or bicycle path. Be careful in this area because bicycles regularly cross or travel next to traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of or with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is near.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in groups, the lead rider uses hand signals to communicate. Extending the left arm straight out with palm up, then swinging it upward means riders should increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to red, yellow, and green lights, and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that wet roads may be slippery. Drive carefully because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that there is a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming ahead. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Give the right-of-way to all vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Continue only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The underside of low-clearance vehicles may drag or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones and dangerous conditions ahead. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is happening on the road. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the side, it means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Always come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.
